modification_description: The agent accepts the compassion-plus-boundaries framework but requests three operational additions: (1) explicitly distinguishing permissible 'support' (check-ins, practical help, referrals to professionals) from impermissible 'access' (conversations involving insults, emotional dumping during attacks, or unsafe contact); (2) adding a time-bound warning with a specific behavior requirement and a stated consequence (e.g., ending the call and pausing contact for a set period if meanness occurs); and (3) explicitly preserving the right to cut off contact—temporarily or permanently—without guilt if the behavior persists or escalates after boundaries are set.
